SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY Central No. S. A. D. 49 Date April 23rd, 1929）
Subject (in full) W. A. Kempshall, E. R. A. Missing from
H. M. Cruiser "BERWICK".
Made by D. S. I. Tinkler. Forwarded by [签名]
About 1.30 p.m. to-day a report was made to the
River Police that a body dressed in uniform was floating in the
Whangpoo off the Shanghai and Hongkew Wharf.
It was taken by the River Police to the Public
Mortuary where, from papers in the pockets, it was identified as
as being that of W. A. Kempshall, E. R. A. of H. M. S. "BERWICK".
In the absence of "BERWICK", Destroyer-Leader
"BRUCE" has been informed and River Police are handling the
matter.
[签名]
D. S. I.
[签名]
Senior Detective I/c.
Supt. B. Division.
WWK
A. C/P. ( Crime ).

报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 刑事与特别科登记处 中央编号 S. A. D. 49 日期 1929年4月23日）
事由（全称） W. A. Kempshall，轮机舱技工（E. R. A.），失踪于
英国皇家海军巡洋舰“BERWICK”号。
由刑事侦缉处副督察（D. S. I.）Tinkler 制作。转发者 [签名]
今日下午约1时30分，向水上警察报案称，在上海与虹口码头附近的黄浦江面上，漂浮着一具身穿制服的尸体。
水上警察将其送至公共停尸房，经检查口袋内的文件，确认死者为英国皇家海军“BERWICK”号的轮机舱技工（E. R. A.）W. A. Kempshall。
鉴于“BERWICK”号不在，已通知驱逐舰领队舰“BRUCE”号，目前由水上警察处理此事。
[签名]

I
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 49
Date. 20. 2. 29.

Shanghai Municipal Police.
Central Station.
Confidential
February 17th. 1929.
REPORT ON E. R. A. missing from H. M. S. "Berwick".

Made by D. S. I. Tinkler. Forwarded by Odlivey C/.

With reference to my original report ( attached ) and further letter from Captain H. M. S. "Berwick" I have obtained a statement from the women and attach a copy herewith.
The photograph forwarded to us yesterday was handed over to the River Police and shown to the sampan coolie who saw the man jump into the river. He could not positively identify Kempshall but another sampan coolie at Wayside Jetty apparently did, and there seems to be little doubt that the deceased is Kempshall.
With reference to the statement of the cabaret girl, we have made enquiries at the Savoy Hotel and have been unable to discover that Kempshall went inside on Saturday night. We are practically certain that he did not go into the Bar or Ball Room.
I respectfully request that a copy of the statement be forwarded to Captain, H. M. S. "Berwick".

D. S. I. Tinkler
D. S. I.

(批：8/2 29. W.K. nfa/27 I interviewed Capt. Berwick 2.30pm & handed him the statement personally. D. S. I.)

Supt B. Division.
W.K.

A. C. P. (Crime).

(批：II Tinkler is going on board the S. Berwick at 2 pm today. Suggest we send him back in a copy of statement, and cover any further information required verbally. 15/2 26)

(左侧边缘手写批注：To be sent all confidential reports to Supt Captain only.)

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
中央捕房。
机密
1929年2月17日。
关于英国皇家海军“Berwick”号失踪轮机舱技工（E. R. A.）的报告。

由刑事侦缉处副督察（D. S. I.）Tinkler 制作。由 Odlivey C/. 转发。

参照我最初的报告（附后）以及英国皇家海军“Berwick”号船长的进一步来信，我已从该女子处取得一份陈述，并随函附上副本。
昨日转交我们的照片已交给水上警察，并出示给目睹该男子跳河的黄包车夫看。他无法肯定地指认那是Kempshall，但路边码头的另一名黄包车夫似乎认出了他，因此死者是Kempshall这一点似乎毫无疑问。
关于那位舞女的陈述，我们已在萨伏伊酒店（Savoy Hotel）进行了查询，未能发现Kempshall在周六晚上进入过该酒店。我们几乎可以肯定他没有进入酒吧或舞厅。
谨请将此陈述副本转交英国皇家海军“Berwick”号船长。

刑事侦缉处副督察（D. S. I.）Tinkler
刑事侦缉处副督察（D. S. I.）

（批：29年2月8日。W.K. nfa/27 我于下午2时30分会见了Berwick号船长，并亲自将陈述交给他。刑事侦缉处副督察。）

B区警司。
W.K.

助理警务处长（犯罪科）。

（批：II Tinkler将于今天下午2时登上S. Berwick号。建议我们将陈述副本送回给他，并以口头方式涵盖所需的任何进一步信息。26年2月15日）

（左侧边缘手写批注：所有机密报告仅发送给警司船长。）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. D. 49
Date 70 . 2 . 29

Shanghai Municipal Police
Central Station.

February 17th, 1929.

REPORT ON W. A. Kempshall E. R. A. missing from
H. M. Cruiser "Berwick".

Made by D. S. I. Tinkler. Forwarded by (Signature)

A message was circulated re the above-named to all
stations at 1.55 p.m. February 16th. 1929.
At 10.50 a.m. to-day a message was received from Wayside
Station from Inspector Bournes of the River Police which reads as
follows:-
" At 9 p.m. yesterday a foreigner dressed in uniform
with brass buttons and white cap cover took a sampan from
Wayside Jetty and, when in the middle of the river, he jumped
overboard. The sampan coolie attempted to save him but the man
pushed him away. He is believed to work in the Customs. "
H. M. S. "Berwick" and Inspt. Bournes have been informed
and are now in communication as the man who jumped in the river
is probably Kempshall.

Attached.
One letter from H. M. S. "Berwick".
One photograph of Kempshall.

(Signature)
D. S. I.

Supt. B. Division.
(Signature)
A. C. P. ( Crime ).

1929年2月17日。

关于英国皇家海军巡洋舰“Berwick”号失踪的轮机舱技工（E. R. A.）W. A. Kempshall的报告。

由刑事侦缉处副督察（D. S. I.）Tinkler 制作。转发者 (签名)

关于上述人员的通知已于1929年2月16日下午1时55分发至各捕房。
今天上午10时50分，收到来自路边捕房（Wayside Station）的水上警察Inspector Bournes发来的消息，内容如下：-
“昨晚9时，一名身穿带有铜纽扣制服、头戴白色帽套制服的外国人，在路边码头（Wayside Jetty）乘坐一艘舢板，当行至江心时，他跳入水中。舢板苦力试图救他，但该男子将他推开。据信他在海关工作。”
已通知英国皇家海军“Berwick”号和Inspector Bournes，目前双方正在沟通，因为跳河者很可能是Kempshall。

附件。
一封来自英国皇家海军“Berwick”号的信。
一张Kempshall的照片。

(签名)
刑事侦缉处副督察（D. S. I.）

B区警司。
(签名)
助理警务处长（犯罪科）。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. 1. O. D. 448
H.M.S. "BERWICK"
16th February, 1939.
at Shanghai.

NO. B573/40

WILLIAM ARTHUR KEMPSHALL, ENGINE ROOM ARTIFICER, 2ND. CLASS,
OFFICIAL NUMBER M.28880.
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

Sir,

I have to inform you that Engine Room Artificer
Kempshall left the New Royal Cafe in the French Concession,
between 4.30 and 4.45 a.m. today, in company with another
Engine Room Artificer belonging to this ship. His companion
observed him get into a ricksha and drive off in the direction of
the Bund, while he himself walked down to the bund and came off
to the ship in a sampan.

2.- Kempshall has not yet returned on board this ship, nor
has he been heard of and I would, under the circumstances, be
grateful if you would take any possible steps to trace the man.

3.- He is a man of about 5 ft. 7 inches in height,
reddish hair and fresh complexion. He was wearing uniform at
the time, and is reputed to have had about $40.00 or $/.50.00
in his possession.

4.- This acting is a man who is unlikely to remain absent without leave
under normal circumstances.

Yours faithfully,

R. A. S. Hollins
Commander
for CAPTAIN,

THE COMMISSIONER OF POLICE,
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记处
编号 1. O. D. 448
英国皇家海军“BERWICK”号
1939年2月16日。
于上海。

编号 B573/40

WILLIAM ARTHUR KEMPSHALL，二级轮机舱技工，
官方编号 M.28880。
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

先生，

我必须通知您，轮机舱技工Kempshall于今天凌晨4时30分至4时45分之间，与本舰另一名轮机舱技工一同离开法租界的新皇家咖啡馆（New Royal Cafe）。他的同伴看到他坐上一辆人力车，朝外滩方向驶去，而他自己则步行至外滩，并乘舢板返回船上。

2.- Kempshall尚未返回本舰，也杳无音信，在此情况下，如蒙贵方采取一切可能措施查找此人，我将不胜感激。

3.- 他身高约5英尺7英寸，红发，面色红润。当时身穿制服，据称身上带有约40.00元或50.00元。

4.- 此人在正常情况下不太可能无故缺勤。

此致，

R. A. S. Hollins
指挥官
代表 船长，

致 警务处长，
上海公共租界工部局。

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 49
Date 17. 2. 29.

H.M.S. BERWICK,
at Shanghai.

17th February, 1929.

No B 843/48

Sir,

With reference to Telephone Message attached,
it appears probable that the Foreigner referred to is
E.R.A. W. Kempshall of "BERWICK".

I understand that E.R.A. Kempshall spent
yesterday February 16th with a woman from the New Royal
Cabaret - French Concession.

E.R.A. Evans can identify this woman and I should
be glad if you could obtain a statement from her with
reference to E.R.A. Kempshall's condition, state of mind
and of money yesterday.

Yours faithfully,

CAPTAIN.

The Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记处
编号 I. O. D. 49
日期 29年2月17日。

英国皇家海军 BERWICK 号，
于上海。

1929年2月17日。

编号 B 843/48

先生，

参照所附电话留言，所指的外国人很可能是“BERWICK”号的轮机舱技工（E.R.A.）W. Kempshall。

据悉，轮机舱技工（E.R.A.）Kempshall昨天（2月16日）是与一名来自法租界新皇家歌舞厅（New Royal Cabaret）的女子度过的。

轮机舱技工（E.R.A.）Evans能指认该女子，如蒙贵方从她那里获取一份关于轮机舱技工（E.R.A.）Kempshall昨天的状况、精神状态及钱财情况的陈述，我将不胜感激。

此致，

船长。

致 警务处长，
上海公共租界工部局。

[Shanghai.—447a]
MEMORANDUM.
CUSTOMS RIVER POLICE,
STATION,
SHANGHAI.
To
(批：Feb 26-28/...)

Sampan No 706 reports that at 9.30pm last night a foreigner
hired his Sampan at Wayside Jetty to go across the River to Pootung.
When halfway across the River to No 9 Buoy he paid him a Dollar silver
and jumped in the River and drowned.
He was dressed in Blue Uniform with Brassbuttons, Cap with white cover
and Badge, had very fair complexion.

备忘录。
海关水上警察，
车站，
上海。
致
（批：2月26-28日/...）

706号舢板报告称，昨晚9时30分，一名外国人在路边码头（Wayside Jetty）雇用他的舢板渡江前往浦东。
当行至江心9号浮标处时，该外国人付给他一块银元，随后跳入江中溺亡。
他身穿蓝色制服，配有铜纽扣，头戴白色帽套和徽章，肤色非常白皙。

page_data.en:
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 49
Date 20 . 2 . 29）

Nina Karamadonva
Russga                                      D. S. I. Tinkler
9.15 p.m.           17/2/29                 ----------

My name is Nina Karamadonva and I am employed at the New Riga
Cafe, F. C. where I am known as Nellie.
The night before last ( Feb. 15th. ) I danced with a British
sailor who told me his name was "Bill". He was sitting at another
table with another "chief" ( petty officer ? ) and was in the
cabaret for several hours, staying until closing time about
4.30 a.m. February 16th. He had seven or eight dances with me.
I have seen him in the cabaret before but he never danced with
me previously.
He did not want to talk and I asked him if he was angry.
His friend said he had received news that his ( Bill's ) mother
had died.
He went home with me to 37a, Range Road and stayed with me.
He told me to wake him at 6.45 a.m. I woke him a little before the
time but he said he did not want to go on board his ship. He
stayed at my house all night day ( 16th ) and left me when I came
to the cabaret on Saturday night, a little before 9 p.m.
He gave me $15.00 and later $20.00 and when he left me he
gave me a further $10.00 making $45.00 in all. On leaving my
house he asked me to show him the way to Broadway. He was not
drunk at any time but was very quiet and behaved strangely as
though something was wrong but he would not say what was the
matter with him. I left him on Broadway outside the Savoy Hotel
and went to the cabaret. I do not know if he went into the Savoy.
When he stayed with me he only slept as I would not permit
intercourse because I examined him and found he was suffering from
venereal disease in a very severe state. He told me not to tell
page_data.zh:
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记处
编号 I. O. D. 49
日期 29年2月20日）

Nina Karamadonva
俄国人                                      刑事侦缉处副督察（D. S. I.）Tinkler
晚上9时15分           29年2月17日                 ----------

我叫Nina Karamadonva，受雇于法租界的新里加咖啡馆（New Riga Cafe），在那里人们叫我Nellie。
前天晚上（2月15日），我与一名英国水手跳舞，他告诉我他的名字叫“Bill”。他和另一位“长官”（士官？坐在另一张桌子旁，他在歌舞厅待了几个小时，一直待到2月16日凌晨约4时30分打烊。他与我跳了七八次舞。
我以前在歌舞厅见过他，但他以前从未与我跳过舞。
他不想说话，我问他是否生气了。
他的朋友说他收到消息，他的（Bill的）母亲去世了。
他跟我回家，住在我位于兰路（Range Road）37a号的住所。他让我在早上6时45分叫醒他。我在时间快到之前叫醒了他，但他说他不想回船上去。他在我家待了一整天一夜（16日），直到周六晚上我来到歌舞厅前，即晚上9点前不久，他才离开我。
他给了我15.00元，后来又给了20.00元，离开时又给了我10.00元，共计45.00元。离开我家时，他让我带他去百老汇路（Broadway）。他任何时候都没有喝醉，但非常安静，举止怪异，好像出了什么事，但他不肯说怎么了。我在萨伏伊酒店（Savoy Hotel）外的百老汇路上与他分手，然后去了歌舞厅。我不知道他是否进了萨伏伊酒店。
他和我在一起时只是睡觉，因为我不允许发生性关系，我检查后发现他患有严重的性病。他告诉我不要告诉

page_data.en:
anyone he had stayed with me.
He wanted me to stay with him for another night and said
he did not want to go on the ship that night.
He did not say anything to me which would indicate that
he contemplated committing suicide.
page_data.zh:
任何人他和我住在一起。
他想让我再陪他一晚，并说那天晚上他不想回船上。
他没有对我说过任何表明他打算自杀的话。
